instruction: How to set netem delay for specific traffic via filter
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: prio && tc qdisc add dev eth0 parent 1:3 handle 30: netem delay 200ms && tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip dst 10.0.0.2 flowid 1:3

instruction: How to simulate packet loss only for UDP on eth0
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: prio && tc qdisc add dev eth0 parent 1:3 handle 30: netem loss 10% && tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip protocol 17 0xff flowid 1:3

instruction: How to limit bandwidth for a specific IP
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 30 && tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:10 htb rate 1mbit && tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip src 10.0.0.1 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to set up rate limiting per IP with HTB
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb && for ip in 10.0.0.1 10.0.0.2 10.0.0.3; do tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:$(echo $ip | cut -d. -f4) htb rate 512kbit ceil 1mbit; tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip src $ip flowid 1:$(echo $ip | cut -d. -f4); done

instruction: How to combine HTB and netem
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 30 && tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:10 htb rate 1mbit && tc qdisc add dev eth0 parent 1:10 handle 20: netem delay 50ms loss 2%

instruction: How to add a qdisc hierarchy with prio and netem
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: prio bands 3 && tc qdisc add dev eth0 parent 1:1 handle 10: netem delay 100ms && tc qdisc add dev eth0 parent 1:2 handle 20: pfifo_fast

instruction: How to set up tc with ingress policing
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 ingress && tc filter add dev eth0 parent ffff: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip src 10.0.0.1 police rate 100kbps burst 10k drop

instruction: How to delete a specific class
output: tc class del dev eth0 classid 1:10

instruction: How to delete a specific filter
output: tc filter del dev eth0 parent 1: prio 1

instruction: How to replace a qdisc
output: tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root fq_codel

instruction: How to add a qdisc with handle for a child class
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 parent 1:10 handle 20: sfq perturb 10

instruction: How to use tc to shape traffic based on port
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 30 && tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:10 htb rate 5mbit && tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip dport 80 0xffff flowid 1:10

instruction: How to prioritize ACK traffic over other traffic
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip protocol 6 0xff match tcp flags 0x10 0xff priority 1

instruction: How to use tc with iptables connmark
output: iptables -A FORWARD -t mangle -j CONNMARK --restore-mark && tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: handle 1 fw flowid 1:10

instruction: How to use tc with iptables to DSCP
